material.description: From hy3d's consolidated gap list (worldmech-parity.tsv, items2-parity.tsv). cmd_set_item_charges 0 empties the slot; there is no ground-item storage for bottle or runes; the aegis is not drawn as a ground item; drop rules are missing. Proposed, not approved.

notes.note: blocked_by: test-file edit. 6.88g runes are ground items (war3map.j H7V 15484-15503 CreateItem at spots; pickup QKV 18653, QIV 18495; probe dispatch 1793541911998-4920-940ecc23f262cdd5). The tree models a rune as a map unit of kind bounty_rune (scenarios/moba/camps.lua:114-120, claim_rune 229-233, rune_round 260-276). Gates encode the unit model: rust/gate/src/mechanic_checks.rs spawn_group_pickup (246-278 asserts the rune unit dies on pickup and is alive after the next round); bottle_rune, bottle_rune_expires, bottle_rune_warning, bottle_capture_cast and hero_death_drop (320) find the rune as a player 0xFF hp 1 unit. A Lua-only change to ground items turns those gates red on push, and fixing them edits test files, which this walk forbids. Refuted as open gaps: C1 setter exists (piccolo_host.rs:1892, ground.rs:111, gated via mechanic-bottle-share-dose); C3 aegis is dropped (camps.lua:376-377), picked up (332-351), drawn (fx.js:924-949), gated (mechanic_checks.rs:316); C4 drop rules exist (ground.rs:42-60, ctl_checks.rs:115, camps.lua:353-365). Receipts: .gm/receipts/proposed-items-ground-charges-bottle-rune/01-orient.md, 02-unknowns.md, 03-eliminate.md. Owner decision needed: approve the gate rewrite for rune ground items, or close the row as refuted with the unit model.
